```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(methrix)
library(tidyverse)


meth <- load_HDF5_methrix(dir = "Z:/omics/EM-seq_UU/h5_raw_data/")

```

```{r message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

colnames(meth) <- colnames(meth) %>%
  gsub("_R1_val_1_bismark_bt2_pe", "", .) %>%
  gsub("UA-2825-", "CZC", .)

phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022.12.01 <- read.csv("Z:/omics/Phenotype/phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022-12-01.csv")
meth <- methrix::subset_methrix(meth, samples = colnames(meth)[colnames(meth) %in% phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022.12.01$subject.id])

#exclude samples with low quality - see the readme file:

#UA-2825-3873 - 3.1%

#UA-2825-3293 - 1.3%

#The following samples has lower alignment rate (< 75%) and coverage (< 20X):
  
#UA-2825-2567** - alignment rate 71.8 %, mean coverage 21.6 X

#UA-2825-2767** - alignment rate 63.3 %, mean coverage 18.6 X

#UA-2825-2847** - alignment rate 57.4 %, mean coverage 16.9 X

samples_to_exclude <- paste0("CZC", c("3873", "3293", "2567", "2767", "2847"))

meth <- methrix::subset_methrix(meth, samples = colnames(meth)[!(colnames(meth) %in% samples_to_exclude)])


rownames(phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022.12.01) <- phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022.12.01$subject.id
coldata <- phenotypes_from_phenopackets_2022.12.01[colnames(meth),]
colData(meth) <- DataFrame(coldata)



```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

methrix_report(meth, output_dir = "report", recal_stats = T)

```

```{r message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
meth <- coverage_filter(
  meth,
  cov_thr = 5,
  prop_samples = 0.5,
  group = NULL,
  n_chunks = 5,
  n_cores = 1
)


meth <- mask_methrix(meth, low_count = 5)
meth <- remove_uncovered(meth)

 
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}
 save_HDF5_methrix(meth, dir="Z:/omics/EM-seq_UU/h5_QC_filtered/", replace = T)

  
```

```{r message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

meth <- methrix::remove_snps(meth, n_chunks = 10, n_cores = 1, keep = T)



```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE}

save_HDF5_methrix(meth$snp_filtered, dir="h5_QC_SNP_filtered/", replace = T)
save_HDF5_methrix(meth$removed_snps, dir="h5_QC_removed_SNPs/", replace = T)

```
